queries.title: Onboarded devices not reporting (silent sensors)
queries.description: Devices marked Onboarded whose sensor is no longer Active or that haven't checked in for 7+ days. The portal's green status only reflects EDR telemetry reaching the cloud, so these silent sensors hide in plain sight.

queries.title: Devices that can be onboarded but aren't
queries.description: Devices Defender knows about and could manage, still sitting in 'Can be onboarded' state — the cross-system coverage gap between inventory and actual EDR protection.

queries.title: Antivirus configuration not compliant
queries.description: Devices failing one or more Defender Antivirus secure-configuration checks (real-time protection, signature freshness, tamper protection, etc.) from TVM's configuration assessment.

queries.title: Recent malware detections (last 7 days)
queries.description: Devices with malware-category alerts in the past week, ranked by distinct alert count with a sample of alert titles.

queries.title: Devices with high-severity alerts (last 30 days)
queries.description: Triage shortlist: devices carrying high-severity alerts in the past 30 days, ranked by distinct alert count with sample titles.

queries.title: High volume LSASS memory read
queries.description: Identifies processes extracting an abnormally large volume of memory (>40MB) from LSASS. A hit indicates likely credential dumping, even if the process runs as SYSTEM, because it tracks physical bytes copied rather than process identity.

queries.title: Suspicious LSASS access request by non-system account
queries.description: Flags interactive (non-SYSTEM) user accounts requesting highly privileged access masks against LSASS. A hit catches credential dumping intent at handle-request time, even if the memory read later fails or is delayed.

queries.title: Private Key Files
queries.description: Finds file operations on files with extensions commonly used to store private keys (.pfx/.pfn/.p12). A hit may indicate an attacker locating exportable certificates that could be brute-forced offline.

queries.title: Active Directory Sensitive Group Modifications
queries.description: Shows all membership changes to Tier 0 Active Directory groups (Domain Admins, Schema Admins, Enterprise Admins, etc.). A hit means a privileged group changed and should be confirmed as authorized. Requires Defender for Identity.

queries.title: Potential Microsoft Defender Tampering
queries.description: Identifies attempts to stop, disable, or reconfigure Microsoft Defender services via sc/net/taskkill/PowerShell/registry edits. A hit suggests an actor is disabling endpoint protection before further activity.

queries.title: Clear system logs with fsutil
queries.description: Detects use of fsutil.exe to delete the USN change journal, an anti-forensic technique seen in ransomware campaigns. A hit indicates an attacker is destroying file-system forensic artifacts.

queries.title: Shimcache flushed
queries.description: Searches for attempts to flush the Shimcache (AppCompatCache) via rundll32, which may indicate anti-forensic or defense evasion activity. A hit warrants checking why cached execution evidence was cleared.

queries.title: ADFS / domain federation trust modifications
queries.description: Finds changes to domain federation trust settings or switches from managed to federated authentication. A hit can indicate an actor (e.g. Nobelium) adding a trusted signing certificate to forge authentication tokens.

queries.title: Anomaly of MailItemsAccessed by other users' mailbox
queries.description: Looks for users accessing multiple other users' mailboxes, or many folders within another user's mailbox, against a 30-day baseline. A hit may indicate mailbox compromise or unauthorized data collection.

queries.title: SMB shares discovery
queries.description: Finds processes that connected to more than 10 IP addresses over port 445 (SMB), suggesting network share scanning. A hit may indicate reconnaissance ahead of lateral movement.

queries.title: Kerberoasting / AS-REP roasting LDAP queries
queries.description: Detects LDAP queries searching for SPNs (Kerberoasting) or accounts with Kerberos pre-auth disabled (AS-REP roasting), correlated to the originating process. A hit may indicate Rubeus, Kerberoast, or BloodHound activity. Requires Defender for Identity.

queries.title: nbtscan activity
queries.description: Detects execution of nbtscan.exe (by name or known hashes), a NetBIOS scanning tool seen in the Operation Soft Cell campaigns. A hit may indicate internal network reconnaissance.

queries.title: Enumeration of users & groups via net commands
queries.description: Finds attempts to list domain users or groups using net.exe (net user /domain, net group /domain). A hit suggests account discovery often preceding lateral movement.

queries.title: Tor client / Meek plugin connections
queries.description: Looks for active network connections from the Tor client or the Meek pluggable transport, returning prevalence and file hashes. A hit may indicate anonymized C2 or data egress.

queries.title: Connection to rare DNS hosts
queries.description: Breaks remote hostnames into second/third-level domains and surfaces destinations contacted by very few devices. A hit highlights low-prevalence domains that may be C2; expect tuning noise.

queries.title: Mass downloads in the last 7 days
queries.description: Surfaces accounts that downloaded more than 50 files in a 5-minute window, as recorded by Defender for Cloud Apps. A hit may indicate data staging or exfiltration. Requires an MDCA app connector.

queries.title: Entra ID role adds in the last 7 days
queries.description: Lists directory role additions captured by Defender for Cloud Apps, including who was added and by whom. A hit may indicate privilege escalation. Requires an MDCA app connector.

queries.title: MDE: find out-of-date Defender clients
queries.description: Lists onboarded Windows devices whose Defender client version is below a defined baseline. A hit highlights endpoints needing platform/client updates for full protection coverage.

queries.title: MDE: list all not-onboarded endpoints
queries.description: Lists devices seen in the last day whose onboarding status is not 'Onboarded'. A hit highlights gaps in Defender for Endpoint coverage.

queries.title: Proxy configuration changes via registry
queries.description: Detects registry changes to proxy settings (AutoConfigURL / Proxy values). A hit may indicate an attacker redirecting traffic for interception or C2.

queries.title: USB mounted and files copied
queries.description: Correlates USB mount events with files subsequently created on the mounted drive. A hit may indicate data exfiltration to removable media.

queries.title: WDigest credential caching enabled
queries.description: Returns attempts to enable WDigest plaintext credential caching via the UseLogonCredential registry value or equivalent command lines. A hit indicates staging for plaintext credential harvesting.

queries.title: All encoded PowerShell commands executed
queries.description: Finds PowerShell executions using -encodedcommand/-enc, decodes the Base64, and summarizes unique decoded commands per device. A hit surfaces obfuscated PowerShell worth reviewing.

queries.title: AMSI script detections
queries.description: Lists AmsiScriptDetection events, where the Antimalware Scan Interface flagged a script. Because these do not always raise an alert, a hit may reveal malicious scripting that otherwise went unnoticed.

queries.title: Possible webshell on the endpoint
queries.description: Looks for shell processes (cmd, powershell, /bin/bash, etc.) spawned by web server processes (w3wp, httpd, nginx, tomcat). A hit may indicate a webshell executing commands on an internet-facing server.

queries.title: Known shadow copy delete command executed
queries.description: Triggers on known ransomware commands that delete volume shadow copies and backups or disable System Restore. A hit indicates likely pre-ransomware recovery inhibition.

queries.title: NTDS.DIT file modifications
queries.description: Surfaces file-modification events touching the Active Directory database (ntds.dit), summarized by responsible process and account. A hit may indicate domain credential theft, though backup tools can appear too.

queries.title: BloodHound process detection
queries.description: Detects BloodHound/SharpHound usage by its known command-line patterns. A hit may indicate Active Directory attack-path reconnaissance.

queries.title: Scheduled tasks from AppData created or updated
queries.description: Detects scheduled tasks created/updated that reference executables or scripts in AppData, a common low-privilege persistence technique (OneDrive excluded). A hit may indicate malware persistence.

queries.title: Defender AV exclusion events
queries.description: Detects Add-MpPreference/Set-MpPreference adding Defender exclusions (path, extension, process, IP) via command line or PowerShell. A hit indicates an actor carving out blind spots for malware.

queries.title: Security log cleared
queries.description: Triggers on the SecurityLogCleared event. A hit may indicate an actor erasing the Windows Security event log to hide activity (can also be benign when a full log is cleared).

queries.title: User added to sensitive group
queries.description: Detects additions to sensitive AD groups (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Exchange Admins) via Defender for Identity, showing who was added and by whom. A hit may indicate privilege escalation.

queries.title: Anomalous amount of LDAP traffic
queries.description: Baselines per-device LDAP query volume (via Defender for Identity) and flags workstations with anomalous spikes. A hit may indicate reconnaissance using LDAP enumeration.

queries.title: OAuth apps with Mail.* Graph permissions
queries.description: Lists OAuth applications holding Mail.* Microsoft Graph permissions, which grant access to mailbox data. A hit highlights apps that could be abused for mailbox access and warrants consent review.

queries.title: Certutil remote download
queries.description: Detects certutil.exe used with urlcache/-f and an http URL to download remote files, a common LOLBin ingress technique. A hit may indicate tool/payload transfer onto a host.

queries.title: Alternate Data Streams execution
queries.description: Detects suspicious use of NTFS Alternate Data Streams via streams.exe-style command lines, a technique to mask malicious activity seen in ransomware campaigns against healthcare. A hit may indicate hidden payloads stored in ADS.

queries.title: LaZagne SAM credential theft
queries.description: Detects SAM database export via reg.exe save commands, a credential-theft technique used by the LaZagne tool seen in Ryuk ransomware campaigns. A hit suggests an attacker is harvesting stored credentials for lateral movement.

queries.title: Cobalt Strike alert-adjacent logons
queries.description: Joins Cobalt Strike-related alerts (event-log clearing, backup deletion, suspicious decoded content, specific malware names) to logon events on the same device within a 10-day window. A hit surfaces accounts that may have had credentials stolen on a compromised endpoint.

queries.title: Mail permissions added to application [Nobelium]
queries.description: Finds applications granted Mail.Read or Mail.ReadWrite permissions where a user recently consented in the same time window. A hit can reveal an OAuth app abused to read user email, a technique used by Nobelium.

queries.title: Procdump LSASS credential dump
queries.description: Looks for Procdump being used to dump LSASS memory (e.g. via -ma or -accepteula flags), a technique seen in the Exchange Server zero-day attacks. A hit may indicate an attacker has compromised user accounts.

queries.title: LSASS credential dumping (behavioral)
queries.description: Correlates OpenProcess API calls against lsass.exe with a file-creation event from the same process within one minute, catching credential dumping by behavior rather than process name. A hit indicates a process read LSASS memory and wrote a dump file.

queries.title: Kerberos AS authentications
queries.description: Shows attempts to request a Kerberos service ticket via the AS (Authentication Service), which normally issues TGTs. Anomalous AS requests for non-krbtgt SPNs can indicate AS-REP roasting or abnormal Kerberos authentication behavior.

queries.title: Anomalous .NET runtime loading for fileless payload
queries.description: Detects native Windows LOLBins or binaries in user-writable paths loading the .NET CLR (clr.dll, mscoree.dll, coreclr.dll). This kernel-driven telemetry catches in-memory .NET execution and ETW patching used by malware like Kazuar to evade EDR.

queries.title: Short-lived ephemeral code signing certificates
queries.description: Identifies files signed by certificates with a lifespan of 14 days or less on non-developer endpoints, excluding known dev assets. A hit is a high-fidelity indicator of Malware-Signing-as-a-Service abuse (e.g. Fox Tempest) used to bypass SmartScreen and EDR reputation filters.

queries.title: Suspicious base64-encoded registry keys
queries.description: Looks for registry values containing base64-encoded data that decodes to commands, a persistence and obfuscation technique. A hit surfaces potentially hidden commands stored in the registry.

queries.title: First-time network connection by unusual process
queries.description: Baselines [DeviceId + FileName + Signer] network behavior over 14 days and surfaces processes making their first-ever public connection on a host. A hit can reveal DLL sideloading/BYOTA, rogue RMM tools, or droppers beaconing to C2.

queries.title: C2 named pipe creation
queries.description: Detects creation of named pipes matching known APT and C2-framework defaults (PsExec, Cobalt Strike, PoshC2, Covenant, SUNBURST, Project Sauron, etc.). A hit strongly suggests post-exploitation tooling or malware C2 on the host.

queries.title: Browser extension enumeration via DeviceFileEvents
queries.description: Enumerates browser extension CRX files seen across endpoints by extension ID and device count. Useful for hunting potentially malicious or unwanted extensions across the fleet.

queries.title: LDAP password search (enum_ad_user_comments)
queries.description: Detects Active Directory LDAP queries searching user description/comment fields for the string 'pass', covering the Metasploit enum_ad_user_comments tool. A hit suggests an attacker hunting for passwords stored in AD object attributes.

queries.title: Detect inactive AD service accounts
queries.description: Finds Active Directory service accounts (matched by naming prefix) whose last logon was more than 14 days ago. Useful for identifying stale or potentially abandoned privileged accounts.

queries.title: Multiple LDAP queries in a time window
queries.description: Detects devices issuing a high number of distinct Active Directory LDAP queries within a short bin, a signal of reconnaissance/enumeration tooling. A hit may indicate AD discovery by an attacker.

queries.title: Entra ID group adds in the last 7 days
queries.description: Lists Entra ID 'Add member to group' actions by regular users, observed via Defender for Cloud Apps. Useful for reviewing recent group additions that could grant elevated access.

queries.title: LDAP search for vulnerable operating systems
queries.description: Detects AD LDAP queries enumerating computer objects by operatingSystem attribute, covering the Metasploit enum_ad_computers tool. A hit suggests an attacker mapping hosts vulnerable to specific exploits.

queries.title: AD group membership changes (MDI)
queries.description: Finds accounts, users, and devices added to or removed from Active Directory groups, with the initiating actor. Useful for spotting privilege escalation via group manipulation. Note: file contains two separate queries (added / removed) run independently.

queries.title: File download events in the last 7 days
queries.description: Lists file download events captured by Defender for Cloud Apps, including sensitivity labels on the file and site. Useful for exfiltration hunting and reviewing access to labeled content.

queries.title: Host exporting mailbox and removing export [Solorigate]
queries.description: Detects a host running New-MailboxExportRequest followed by Remove-MailboxExportRequest within a short window on an on-prem Exchange server. This pattern, used during the SolarWinds intrusion, indicates email exfiltration with cleanup.

queries.title: AD objects moving between OUs (MDI)
queries.description: Finds user and computer objects whose Account Path changed (moved between Organizational Units), with source/destination path and initiating actor. Useful for detecting unauthorized OU moves that can alter policy/GPO scope. Note: contains two separate queries (users / computers).

queries.title: Find deleted AD accounts and by whom
queries.description: Surfaces Active Directory account-deletion events with the deleted target and the initiating actor. Useful for auditing account removals and spotting unauthorized deletions.

queries.title: Find mounted ISO files and drive letters
queries.description: Correlates ISO file events with related LNK files and MountedDevices registry entries to surface mounted ISO images and their drive letters. ISO-delivered payloads are a common malware delivery technique that bypasses mark-of-the-web.

queries.title: Endpoint health with AV information
queries.description: Reports Defender AV mode (Active, Passive, EDR Blocked, SxS Passive) along with signature/engine versions and last update time per device, using TVM secure-configuration assessment. Useful for spotting devices running with degraded or passive AV.

queries.title: Discover hosts doing possible network scans
queries.description: Flags hosts connecting to many distinct remote ports on a single internal RemoteIP, a signature of port scanning. A hit may indicate internal reconnaissance ahead of lateral movement.

queries.title: Find LNK files on a specific endpoint
queries.description: Lists LNK shortcut file events on a named device, including previous file/folder names. Useful when investigating a specific host for malicious or persistence-related shortcut files.

queries.title: Potential OAuth phishing email delivered into Inbox
queries.description: Triggers when an email containing a Microsoft OAuth consent URL is delivered inbound to an Inbox. Such URLs aren't directly malicious but can be illicit-consent-grant attacks delegating permissions to an attacker-controlled app.

queries.title: Possible device code phishing attempts
queries.description: Correlates user clicks on Microsoft device-login URLs with subsequent risky successful sign-ins and a 50199-then-success error pattern, the signature of Storm-2372 device code phishing. A hit indicates a likely device code phishing compromise.

queries.title: Inbox rule changes which forward/redirect email
queries.description: Hunts for Set-InboxRule operations that create ForwardTo or RedirectTo rules, captured via Defender for Cloud Apps. Auto-forwarding rules are a classic BEC persistence and exfiltration technique.

queries.title: DoppelPaymer stop security services
queries.description: Detects PsExec-launched PowerShell stopping SQL and Exchange services, a step DoppelPaymer ransomware operators take to disable defenses before encryption. A hit suggests imminent ransomware activity.

queries.title: regsvr32/rundll32 DLL loads from abnormal locations
queries.description: Finds rarely-seen DLLs loaded by regsvr32.exe or rundll32.exe from user-writable or unusual paths, then correlates with their on-disk creation. A hit can indicate proxied execution of a malicious DLL (T1218.010/011).

queries.title: MailItemsAccessed anomaly (time series) [Solorigate]
queries.description: Uses series_decompose_anomalies on hourly Exchange MailItemsAccessed counts to flag anomalous spikes above baseline, then joins back the raw events for context. Sudden surges in mailbox access can indicate bulk email collection/exfiltration.

queries.title: PowerShell execution events involving downloads
queries.description: Finds PowerShell command lines containing download cmdlets/keywords (Net.WebClient, DownloadFile, Invoke-WebRequest, Invoke-Shellcode, http:). A hit can indicate a fileless download-and-execute stager.

queries.title: Commandlines with cleartext passwords
queries.description: Lists devices where processes were launched with both a username and a cleartext password on the command line. A hit indicates insecurely stored credentials that adversaries can harvest from process logs.

queries.title: PsExec Usage
queries.description: Lists PsExec executions per initiating device, surfacing the remote devices contacted and commands run. A hit is a starting point to investigate remote command execution, which adversaries abuse for lateral movement.

queries.title: MSHTA Executions
queries.description: Lists all mshta.exe executions, optionally filtered to suspicious child processes. A hit can reveal threat actors using mshta to drop or proxy-execute payloads.

queries.title: Potential Beaconing Activity
queries.description: Detects potential C2 beaconing by finding remote IPs receiving a high average number of connections from few devices, enriched with FileProfile to surface low-prevalence initiating processes. A hit can indicate an active command-and-control channel.

queries.title: Sliver C2 Beacon Loaded
queries.description: Correlates an outbound connection, a \wkssvc named pipe creation, and a samlib.dll image load occurring within seconds in sequence to detect a loaded Sliver C2 beacon. A hit indicates hands-on-keyboard C2 access on the device.

queries.title: Nltest Discovery Activities
queries.description: Triggers when more than three nltest.exe queries are executed by a user on the same device within 30 minutes. A hit suggests an adversary enumerating domain trusts during discovery.

queries.title: Runas with saved credentials
queries.description: Detects runas.exe executions using the /savecred flag, which reuses a stored password to run a process as another user. A hit can indicate an adversary abusing saved credentials for privilege escalation.

queries.title: Wevtutil Clear Windows Event Logs
queries.description: Detects wevtutil.exe being used to clear or attempt to clear Windows Event Logs (System, Application, Security). A hit indicates indicator removal, a common technique to hide intrusion activity.

queries.title: Windows Network Sniffing
queries.description: Detects execution of the built-in Packet Monitor (PktMon.exe), which can capture network traffic. A hit may indicate an adversary sniffing the network to collect credentials or other unencrypted data.

queries.title: Local Administrator Additions
queries.description: Lists local administrators added to the built-in Administrators group (SID S-1-5-32-544) per device within the selected timeframe. A hit can reveal adversaries creating privileged local accounts for persistence.

queries.title: PowerShell Invoke-Webrequest
queries.description: Lists successful public network connections initiated by PowerShell Invoke-Webrequest command lines, with optional filters for servers or IPv4-only downloads. A hit can indicate a remotely downloaded and executed malicious script.

queries.title: Regsvr32.exe created as subprocess by an Office Application
queries.description: Detects regsvr32.exe spawned as a child process of Word, PowerPoint, or Excel. Office apps would not normally launch regsvr32, so a hit suggests proxy execution of malicious code via a malicious document.

queries.title: Malicious PowerShell Executions From Clipboard Copy-and-Paste
queries.description: Hunts for fake CAPTCHA / ClickFix social engineering by correlating an explorer.exe clipboard read with a hidden PowerShell or mshta web request within one minute. A hit suggests a user was lured into pasting and running malicious commands.

queries.title: Suspicious Explorer Child Process
queries.description: Detects explorer.exe spawning a suspicious interpreter child process (cmd, powershell, mshta, rundll32, etc.) with suspicious command-line parameters such as encoded commands or URLs. A hit may indicate a FileFix/ClickFix-style execution that installs malware.

queries.title: Suspicious Browser Child Process
queries.description: Detects a browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave) spawning a suspicious interpreter child process such as cmd, powershell, mshta, or rundll32. A hit may indicate a potentially malicious command that installs malware.

queries.title: Detect new RDP connections
queries.description: Detects RDP connections (port 3389) to devices and accounts that had no such connection in the prior baseline window. A hit highlights newly observed remote desktop activity worth investigating for lateral movement.

queries.title: Local Group Discovery
queries.description: Detects net.exe or net1.exe localgroup enumeration commands, excluding whitelisted departments. A hit from an unexpected department may indicate a compromised account performing permission-group discovery.

queries.title: Executable Files in C:\Users\Public
queries.description: Detects rare executable files (by extension and low global prevalence) created under C:\Users\Public and its subfolders. A hit may indicate an adversary staging payloads in a world-writable location to stay undetected.

queries.title: Rare ISO files on devices
queries.description: Hunts for ISO files on disk with low global prevalence (FileProfile enrichment). A hit may indicate a malicious ISO delivered via email to bypass Mark-of-the-Web and gain initial access.

queries.title: WMIC Remote Command Execution
queries.description: Detects WMIC.exe command lines containing an IP address, indicating remote process execution via WMI. A hit may indicate an adversary using WMIC for lateral movement or remote command execution.

queries.title: LOL Driver Usage
queries.description: Joins file, process, and image-load events against the LOLDrivers SHA1 hash feed to surface known vulnerable/malicious drivers used to bypass security controls. A hit indicates a LOLDriver present or loaded in the environment.

queries.title: RMM Tools with connections
queries.description: Uses the LOLRMM externaldata feed to identify RMM tool executables, then flags devices where those tools made successful network connections. A hit indicates RMM software actively used in the environment, which adversaries abuse for remote access.

queries.title: Suspicious MSBuild Remote Thread
queries.description: Detects MSBuild.exe creating a remote thread (excluding Visual Studio paths), enriched with network and process context. A hit may indicate trusted-developer-utility proxy execution used for C2 or reverse shell activity.

queries.title: Commandline User Addition
queries.description: Detects user accounts being added via net.exe/net1.exe command lines containing both 'add' and 'user'. A hit may indicate an adversary creating an account for persistence after gaining access.

queries.title: Qakbot post compromise commands executed
queries.description: Detects devices/accounts where more than three distinct known Qakbot post-compromise discovery commands (net view, arp -a, ipconfig /all, whoami /all, etc.) were executed. A hit suggests Qakbot post-compromise reconnaissance.

queries.title: List Tampering Attempts
queries.description: Summarizes Defender tampering attempts blocked by tamper protection per device, including the action, target, and initiating command line. A hit may indicate an adversary trying to disable security monitoring.

queries.title: Outbound MSHTA Connection
queries.description: Detects outbound public network connections initiated by mshta.exe. A hit can indicate abuse of the mshta LOLBin as a malware dropper executing remote HTA content.

queries.title: Defender Discovery Activities (Get-MpPreference)
queries.description: Lists executions of Get-MpPreference across process and event tables, which enumerate Defender settings and exclusions. A hit may indicate security software discovery preceding exclusion abuse.

queries.title: AnyDesk makes a remote connection
queries.description: Lists devices where AnyDesk.exe initiated an outbound connection from a private to a public IP (excluding the AnyDesk boot URL). A hit highlights remote access software activity that adversaries abuse.

queries.title: Password change after successful brute force
queries.description: Combines IdentityLogonEvents brute-force indicators (many failed plus successful logons in a window) with a subsequent password change in IdentityDirectoryEvents. A hit suggests an adversary brute-forced an account and changed its password to maintain persistence.

queries.title: Exploit Guard Network Protection Triggered
queries.description: Lists Defender Exploit Guard Network Protection block/audit events (excluding custom block list) with the response category and URL. A hit indicates a user accessed or attempted to access a malicious or phishing website.

queries.title: Potential Kerberos Encryption Downgrade
queries.description: Detects changes to an account's supported Kerberos encryption types (excluding initial deployment). A hit listing weaker ciphers may indicate an adversary enabling downgrade to set up Kerberoasting.

queries.title: Newly identified lateral movement paths to sensitive accounts
queries.description: Surfaces Defender for Identity 'Potential lateral movement path identified' events to sensitive accounts. A newly identified path means a sensitive account could be taken over if the path is followed.

queries.title: OneDrive Sync From Rare IP
queries.description: Correlates high-volume OneDrive FileSyncUploadedFull activity in CloudAppEvents with rare sign-in IPs from Entra sign-in logs. A hit may indicate an adversary syncing OneDrive to their device to exfiltrate data.

queries.title: Activities performed while connected to an Anonymous Proxy
queries.description: Lists CloudAppEvents activities where the connection was flagged as an anonymous proxy, summarized per account. A hit may indicate an attacker masking the source of malicious actions (false positives include iCloud Private Relay).

queries.title: Detect SMB File Copies
queries.description: Detects SMB file copy actions in IdentityDirectoryEvents (excluding whitelisted accounts), surfacing source/destination devices and the copied file. A hit may indicate an adversary distributing malware to remote shares.

queries.title: Hard Delete user performed
queries.description: Lists CloudAppEvents activities where a hard user delete was performed, including the initiating and deleted user. A hit can indicate destructive account removal worth auditing.

queries.title: Malicious email delivered in Microsoft 365
queries.description: Lists emails classified as malicious by inline Threat Intelligence (TIMailData-Inline) in CloudAppEvents, joined to EmailEvents for sender, subject, and recipient. A hit identifies a delivered malicious or phishing message.

queries.title: External admin activities
queries.description: Lists all activities performed by external admin accounts in the tenant, sorted by most actions. A hit highlights external admins who pose elevated risk because they are not internal users.

queries.title: Executable File attachment received
queries.description: Detects inbound emails carrying executable file attachments (exe, dll, lnk, ps1, vbs, etc.), summarizing target mailboxes, senders, and subjects per file. A hit may indicate an attempt to gain initial access via a malicious attachment.

queries.title: List Device Isolations
queries.description: Lists Defender for Endpoint IsolateDevice actions over the last 30 days, including the isolated device, comment, scope, and initiating account. Useful for periodically auditing isolation activity.

queries.title: Typosquatted Email Received
queries.description: Detects inbound emails from sender domains that closely resemble your domain using a Jaccard index over unicode codepoints, configurable between min and max similarity. A hit may indicate a typosquatting phishing attempt impersonating your domain.

queries.title: Potential Phishing Campaign
queries.description: Groups inbound emails sharing the same EmailClusterId from rare sender domains and containing URLs, flagging clusters sent from multiple senders. A hit may indicate a phishing campaign using varied addresses against your organization.

queries.title: Advanced Feature Disabled
queries.description: Detects when a Defender XDR Advanced Feature (EDR block mode, Live Response, tamper protection, etc.) is disabled via SetAdvancedFeatures in CloudAppEvents. A hit indicates a setting change that can significantly increase attack surface.

queries.title: MDI Sensor Deleted
queries.description: Returns results when a Defender for Identity sensor (installed on a DC, ADCS, ADFS, or Entra Connect server) has been deleted. A hit may indicate an adversary reducing identity monitoring coverage.

queries.title: Sentinel Workspace Disconnected
queries.description: Returns results when a Sentinel workspace is removed from Unified XDR (SentinelDisconnectWorkspace). A hit may indicate accidental or deliberate removal that impairs cloud logging visibility.

queries.title: Defender For Endpoint Offboarding Package Downloaded
queries.description: Detects when a Defender for Endpoint offboarding package is downloaded (DownloadOffboardingPkg), a tier-0 action that can remove security tooling from devices. A hit may indicate an attacker preparing to offboard devices and reduce visibility.

queries.title: Live Response Unsigned Script Setting Changes
queries.description: Lists changes to the 'Live Response unsigned script execution' Advanced Feature in Defender for Endpoint. A hit indicates a setting change that can increase exposure by permitting unsigned script execution.

queries.title: Detect PsExec being used to spread files
queries.description: Detects PsExec (identified by the accepteula flag) creating multiple executable files on remote machines within a 10-minute window. A hit may indicate manual ransomware spread (e.g. Ryuk) across the network.

queries.title: Custom Detection Deletion
queries.description: Lists Defender XDR custom detection rule deletions (DeleteCustomDetection) over the last 30 days, including the rule name and query. A hit may indicate an adversary deleting custom detections to stay undetected.

queries.title: Account brute force from public IP
queries.description: Looks for public IP addresses that failed to log on to a device many times using multiple accounts and eventually succeeded. A hit indicates a successful brute-force / password-spray against a device.

queries.title: Network Logons with Local Accounts
queries.description: Hunts for a high volume of network-based authentications using local credentials from a single source IP. A hit may indicate an attacker beachhead using local account credential replay across many machines.

queries.title: Procdump dumping LSASS credentials
queries.description: Looks for Procdump being used to dump memory from LSASS. A hit strongly suggests an attacker is harvesting credentials from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service.

queries.title: Detect suspicious RDP activity related to BlueKeep
queries.description: Locates Windows 7 / Server 2008 machines making outbound TCP/3389 connections via uncommon processes. A hit may indicate scanning or worm-like spread exploiting CVE-2019-0708 (BlueKeep).

queries.title: Credential harvesting through WDigest cache
queries.description: Returns attempts to enable WDigest credential caching via the registry or command line (UseLogonCredential = 1). A hit indicates an attacker is preparing to capture plaintext credentials from memory.

queries.title: Detect credential theft via SAM database export by LaZagne
queries.description: Detects use of reg.exe to save the HKLM SAM hive, a technique used by the LaZagne credential theft tool. A hit indicates an attacker is exporting stored account password hashes.

queries.title: Device Logons from Unknown IP Addresses
queries.description: Identifies device logons from public IP addresses not associated with any known device in Defender. A hit may surface external interactive access from unrecognized infrastructure.

queries.title: Find user accounts potentially affected by Cobalt Strike
queries.description: Correlates Cobalt-Strike-related alerts with logon events to list accounts that signed in to compromised endpoints around the alert window. A hit identifies accounts whose credentials may have been stolen.

queries.title: Possible Webshell Drop
queries.description: Looks for web page content files (asp, aspx, php, jsp, etc.) created by IIS or Apache worker processes, with throttling to reduce WebDAV false positives. A hit may indicate an attacker dropped a web shell for arbitrary code execution.

queries.title: Accessibility Features persistence / privilege escalation
queries.description: Hunts for abuse of Windows accessibility binaries (sethc.exe, utilman.exe, osk.exe, etc.) via Image File Execution Options debuggers, file overwrites, or anomalous hashes. A hit may indicate a SYSTEM-level backdoor (e.g. sticky keys).

queries.title: Active Directory Sensitive/Tier 0 Group Modifications
queries.description: Shows additions/removals to highly sensitive Tier 0 AD groups (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Schema Admins, etc.) via Defender for Identity. A hit may indicate privilege escalation or a persistence foothold. Requires the IdentityDirectoryEvents table (Defender for Identity).

queries.title: Scheduled Task Created (non-SYSTEM)
queries.description: Surfaces ScheduledTaskCreated events not initiated by the SYSTEM account. A hit may indicate an attacker establishing persistence via a scheduled task.

queries.title: Detect nbtscan activity
queries.description: Detects execution or presence of nbtscan.exe (by name or known SHA1) used to enumerate NETBIOS nameservers. A hit may indicate network reconnaissance, as seen in Operation Soft Cell.

queries.title: Detect LDAP queries searching for roastable accounts
queries.description: Detects LDAP queries searching for Kerberoastable SPNs or accounts without Kerberos preauthentication (AS-REP roasting) via Defender for Identity, joined to the initiating process from device network events. A hit may indicate Rubeus/Kerberoast/BloodHound recon. Requires IdentityQueryEvents (Defender for Identity).

queries.title: Account creation masquerading as administrator
queries.description: Queries UserAccountCreated events for new accounts whose names resemble "administrator" (ad... or suffix). A hit may indicate an attacker creating a lookalike local account for persistence.

queries.title: SMB shares discovery (network scanning)
queries.description: Finds processes that connected to more than 10 distinct IP addresses over port 445 (SMB), possibly scanning for network shares. A hit may indicate Network Share Discovery (T1135).

queries.title: Detect not active AD service accounts
queries.description: Identifies Active Directory service accounts (matching a naming prefix) whose last logon was more than 14 days ago via Defender for Identity. Useful for spotting stale or unused privileged accounts. Requires IdentityLogonEvents (Defender for Identity).

queries.title: Detect clearing of system logs (fsutil USN journal)
queries.description: Detects use of fsutil.exe to delete the USN change journal, removing forensic artifacts. A hit indicates anti-forensic / defense-evasion activity common to ransomware campaigns.

queries.title: Detect use of Alternate Data Streams
queries.description: Detects command lines consistent with executing payloads hidden in NTFS Alternate Data Streams. A hit may indicate an attempt to mask malicious activity, including in-memory ransomware.

queries.title: 7-Zip used to prepare data for exfiltration
queries.description: Detects 7z.exe archiving content from ProgramData\pst, a pattern observed in Exchange zero-day attacks. A hit may indicate an attacker compressing mailbox/PST data prior to exfiltration.

queries.title: Potential Microsoft Defender services tampering
queries.description: Identifies attempts to stop, disable, or reconfigure Microsoft Defender services and protections (Set-MpPreference disables, service stops, registry passive-mode/DisableAntiSpyware edits). A hit indicates defense-evasion tampering with the AV/EDR stack.

queries.title: Tor client / Meek plugin connections
queries.description: Looks for active network connections initiated by tor.exe or the Meek pluggable transport (meek-client.exe), summarizing prevalence by device. A hit may indicate multi-hop proxy C2 or anonymized exfiltration.

queries.title: Detect multiple sensitive LDAP queries
queries.description: Detects a high volume of distinct sensitive LDAP queries (roasting filters or queries against sensitive AD objects) within a time bin via Defender for Identity. A hit may indicate automated recon by Rubeus/Kerberoast/BloodHound. Requires IdentityQueryEvents (Defender for Identity).

queries.title: List files copied to USB mounted drives
queries.description: Correlates FileCreated events on removable drive letters with the most recent USB drive mount events to list files copied to external USB media, with drive serial/manufacturer context. Useful for hunting data theft to USB.

queries.title: Connection to Rare DNS Hosts
queries.description: Breaks remote URLs into second/third-level domains and surfaces low-prevalence destinations contacted by few devices. A hit may surface beaconing to rare C2 domains; expect tuning/noise.

queries.title: Detect suspicious Mshta usage
queries.description: Detects mshta.exe launching with a <script> tag in its command line. A hit may indicate an attacker using mshta to run malicious JavaScript/VBScript (e.g. Ursnif).

queries.title: Detect Encoded PowerShell
queries.description: Detects encoded PowerShell command lines via regex on the -EncodedCommand parameter and decodes the base64 payload, working even if the PowerShell binary was renamed. A hit may indicate obfuscated malicious execution.

queries.title: Webserver Executing Suspicious Applications
queries.description: Finds IIS/Apache worker processes spawning scripting, profiling, or admin tools (cmd, powershell, net, whoami, ping, sc, etc.). A hit may indicate web shell or post-exploitation activity on a web server.

queries.title: Detect Office products launching wmic.exe
queries.description: Detects Word, Excel, or Outlook spawning wmic.exe. A hit may indicate malicious macro/document activity abusing WMI for recon or execution.

queries.title: Stopping multiple processes using taskkill.exe
queries.description: Detects at least 10 distinct processes stopped via taskkill.exe within a 2-minute window. A hit may indicate ransomware terminating security tools, databases, or backups before encryption.

queries.title: Detect attempts to turn off System Restore
queries.description: Detects rundll32 with an empty command line spawning schtasks.exe to disable the SystemRestore scheduled task. A hit indicates an attacker inhibiting recovery, common to ransomware.

queries.title: Return backup files deletion events
queries.description: Returns alerts titled "File backups were deleted". A hit indicates an attacker (often ransomware) is inhibiting recovery by destroying backups.

queries.title: Endpoint Agent Health Status Report
queries.description: Reports Defender for Endpoint best-practice configuration states (sensor, tamper protection, AV, real-time protection, cloud protection, etc.) per device, flagging non-compliant settings as BAD. Useful for MDE deployment health and coverage gaps.

queries.title: Crash Detector
queries.description: Identifies crashing processes from werfault.exe command lines and joins back to the originating process launch. Useful for spotting exploitation attempts (repeated crashes) or unstable malicious binaries.

queries.title: Suspicious URL Clicked
queries.description: Correlates Office 365 ATP phishing-URL alerts, email metadata, identity info, and the device BrowserLaunchedToOpenUrl event to confirm a user clicked a malicious phishing link on their device. A hit confirms phishing link engagement end-to-end.

queries.title: Endpoint AV version report
queries.description: Reports Microsoft Defender Antivirus engine version, security intelligence version and timestamp, platform version, and AV mode (Active/Passive/EDR Blocked) per device. Useful for spotting stale signatures or AV running in passive mode.
queries.credit: António Vasconcelos, Michael Melone, Tali Ash, Juli Hooper (Microsoft)

queries.title: Phishing email URL redirection (t-dot redirector)
queries.description: Detects emails containing the distinctive open-redirector URL pattern (hxxps://t[.]domain[.]tld/r/?), optionally narrowed to known malicious domain patterns. A hit may indicate a phishing campaign using URL redirection for evasion.

queries.title: Appspot Phishing Abuse
queries.description: Surfaces phishing emails with URLs on appspot.com subdomains that embed the recipient's email address (plaintext or base64) in the URI. A hit may indicate a credential-phishing campaign abusing Google App Engine.

queries.title: Files from malicious sender present on devices
queries.description: Joins email attachments from a specified malicious sender address to device file events by SHA256 to find where those files landed on endpoints. A hit shows devices that received a known-bad emailed file.
